metadata.description: JapanFold: hosted biomolecular structure prediction, binder design and protein embeddings on Tenstorrent.

plugins.name: japanfold
plugins.description: Fold proteins/complexes and estimate binding affinity (Boltz-2, ESMFold2, Protenix, OpenFold3, OpenBind-0, OpenDDE), design de-novo binders (BoltzGen, RFdiffusion3, PXDesign) and compute protein embeddings (ESMC, SaProt) via the free JapanFold HTTP API. No API key or local GPU needed.
